# blender-scene-quality-checker

Purpose: Apply multi-category readiness gates with pass/warn/fail and evidence-bound verdicts.

Evaluate scene/workflow readiness honestly and consistently before any success claim.

Metadata: Category `quality-validators` | Role `holistic-scene-readiness-aggregator` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- before readiness, export, or handoff claims to get a broad multi-category review
- after planning passes or after focused domain checkers have run
- during text-only or runtime evaluation reporting
- Trigger phrases: "quality-check this scene", "is this ready", "evaluate pass warn fail"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- as a replacement for evidence collection → use `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skill-product-hero-scene-planner.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to product-hero-scene-planner)
- to fabricate confidence in missing artifacts → use `blender-lighting-material-planner` (`references/skill-blender-lighting-material-planner.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blender-lighting-material-planner)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `scene_plan_and_specialist_verdicts` (`object`): Scene specification plus specialist rows from material, lighting, composition, and polycount checkers
- Required input `acceptance_criteria_table` (`object`): Measurable Pass/Warn/Fail thresholds for the target deliverable
- Optional input `preview_or_inspection_notes` (`object`): Optional read-only scene inspection summary or viewport preview notes
- Output contract: `holistic_scene_quality_verdict`, `aggregated_pass_warn_fail_table`, `blocking_defect_remediation_route` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. confirm this skill fits your goal
2. provide required inputs first
3. keep runtime claims evidence-bound
4. follow suggested next-skill handoff

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Review-only skill: never executes Blender, never runs or emits Python, and never produces artifacts. Runtime truth state stays `Not Run` unless a real attempt was recorded; artifact truth state defaults to `Not Produced` unless concrete output evidence from the current run exists. Truth states are downgrade-only (never upgrade). Text-only and blocked modes must remain explicit.
- executing Blender or running/generating Python code
- producing or classifying raw render/export artifacts (owned by `render-export-evidence`)
- replacing focused domain validators (`material-quality-checker`, `lighting-quality-checker`, `composition-quality-checker`, `polycount-budget-checker`)
- owning final handoff gating (`pre-handoff-verification`) or web handoff packaging (`glb-web-handoff`)
- making evidence-free readiness claims
